name: Ju Duo Zai
parentage: An old, native Phoenix Mountain varietal.
description: 'Saw-leaf'. A rare, old-grove Dan Cong varietal from the Phoenix Mountains, named for the sharply serrated, saw-like edges of its leaves. It is a rustic and powerful tea, known for its wild, herbal, and stone fruit character, representing an older, less-manicured style of Dan Cong.
plantType: Medium-sized Dan Cong arbor with distinctive, sharply serrated leaves (Camellia sinensis var. sinensis).
environment: Grows in the old tea gardens of the Phoenix Mountains, often from trees that are quite old. The specific terroir contributes to its rustic and deep flavor.
processing: Processing this old-grove varietal follows traditional methods. The tea master aims to capture the full, complex character of the leaves rather than targeting a single, narrow fragrance profile.
oxidation: Undergoes a medium-to-heavy oxidation (40-55%) to develop its deep fruit notes and complex, rustic flavor base.
roasting: Typically receives a medium charcoal roast to integrate its powerful flavors, add depth, and ensure the tea will age well.
versatility: Highly specialized. Ju Duo Zai is a specific, old-style Dan Cong oolong appreciated for its rustic power and complexity.

Dan Cong Oolong.Ju Duo Zai Dan Cong: A traditionally processed Dan Cong oolong where the processing aims to express its wild, deep, and untamed character.

sensory.aroma: Wild herbs, stone fruit (apricot), honey, wet stone
sensory.flavor: Rustic, deep, and mineralic with a complex, slightly wild sweetness and a powerful finish.
sensory.mouthfeel_liquor: Thick, full-bodied, and powerful, often with a noticeable energetic character. The liquor is a deep golden-amber.
